The '''Suhuurmin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Quence sector/Legends|Quence sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a group of [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] that was not authorized by the Empire operated out of the Suhuurmin system.<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'' is set in the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates those two battles to the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], respectively, while establishing the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] as the final event before the beginning of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] organization [[Mantis Syndicate]] exterminated the group.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Suhuurmin system was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', which was written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="GG9" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the system in grid square P-18.<ref name="EAOC" />
